hadith.body:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited the practice of Najsh.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim].
- وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نهى عن النَجَش، ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
Ibn 'Umar (Semoga Allah meredai mereka) berkata: Rasulullah (ﷺ) melarang amalan Najsh. [Al-Bukhari dan Muslim].
